subject: Reference-modification
notes: The POSITIVE half (a function-identifier IS admissible as identifier-1) and the NEGATIVE half (it shall be an alphanumeric, boolean, or national function) are both enforced. Before fix-queue PB8 the shape was a COBOL0001 parse error at every edition, so neither half could be reached. A non-conforming class is rejected with COBOL1629; national and alphanumeric results are covered by the golden, and the user-defined-function result reference-modifies through RefModPlace using the RETURNING item's own category.
